overview: 2026年，公司通过多次新股发行进行集资，并续期了与关联方的经常性关联交易授权；季度营收同比增长17.4%，净利润同比增长11.8%。公告中未披露具体业务板块的扩张、缩减或合约信息。
overview_en: In 2026, the company raised funds through multiple new share issuances and renewed its shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions; quarterly revenue grew 17.4% year-on-year and net profit grew 11.8%. No specific segment expansion, reduction, or contract information was disclosed in the announcements.

segments.name: 集团

segments.note_en: Company-level fund raising and renewal of related party transaction mandate; no specific segment updates disclosed.
